newsitem.title: USA: Fed added via five-day fixed system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed added via five-day fixed system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves Thursday through a round of five-day system repurchase agreements, the New York Fed confirmed.
The RPs were for fixed collateral.
The operation was expected, according to economists surveyd earlier by Reuters.

Analysts said the add need in the current maintenance period is above $6 billion a day. Part of the add need was taken care of Wednesday, when the Fed permanently added reserves by making an outright purchase of bills.
